metadata.description: Collection of Claude plugins for output styles, agents, and skills focused on development.

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Strategic git commit plugin — semantic analysis, whole-file staging, hook-validated commits, native git hooks, and safety hooks

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Independent Codex-based code review of the current git diff. Provides the /codex-review skill which runs codex-review.sh and presents the verdict, summary, and findings.

plugins.name: session
plugins.description: Session lifecycle helpers for Claude Code. The /report skill writes a handoff report under .harness/sessions/, the directory shared with the Codex session plugin, that keeps verified work, pending verification, hypotheses and missing information apart, records who made each decision and which tool wrote the report, and lists pending items with their origin and evidence; /report commits the new file in an isolated, verified chore: commit unless --no-commit is given. The /recall skill lists, filters, searches and resumes reports from any tool that follows the same contract through five read-only subcommands (list, filter, grep, resume, last), and checks the current state of pending items before offering them as work.

plugins.name: pragma
plugins.description: Standing working directives, injected as session context by a SessionStart hook, and a review gate that holds the agent to them. Four rules: verify a disputed claim before conceding it and say when the user is wrong; treat a complaint as a question, not a request to build something; never present a dominated option as a live alternative; and never report a result that was not run, or work as done while a known inconsistency in it is open. The gate has an isolated, tool-less reviewer check each AskUserQuestion and each turn end against the user's request and the transcript, and returns proven pending obligations to the agent within a per-request budget.

plugins.name: axio
plugins.description: Skills for using axio, the Go structured logging library. The axio skill is the entry point and covers the API end to end: logger, annotations, configuration, outputs, PII masking on by default, the audit hash chain, wide events, hooks, tracing and metrics, and the axio command. The migration skill moves code from log, slog, logrus, zerolog, zap or apex/log.
